First of 17 Tarlac towns I'll be filming as part of my Philippine hometowns series.  Derived from the Hispanized term derived from the Ilocano term "pampaniki", Paniqui is mainly a agricultural town with a population of around 106,190 people. It is 22km from Tarlac City and sits along MacArthur Highway, serving as a transit corridor for travellers heading towards the provinces in Region I within northern Luzon. #tarlac #paniqui #cinematography #filmmaking #hometown

“No matter what crazy idea I come up with, he’ll always come with me. It’s one of the things I love most about him.” — Marlen “That’s kind of how we are together. She’s always saying, ‘Let’s hike this volcano,’ or, ‘Let’s wake up at two in the morning for the sunrise.’ And I’m usually the one saying, ‘Okay.’ We met six years ago on a rubber boat floating down the river in Zurich. A few years later, Marlen said we should quit our jobs and travel for a year. It took some convincing, but I realized there’s never a perfect time to do something like that. If I hadn’t gone, I’d probably have regretted it forever. Now we’re finally back in Switzerland, and for the first time in our lives, we don’t really know what the future will look like. I think we’re excited to find out.” — Olly Zurich, Switzerland Life on Film  #lifeonfilm
